title: WhatsApp Marketing: The Ultimate Guide (2026) | Salesforce

facts.fact: Salesforce's page states that WhatsApp had more than 3 billion active users in 2026 and is the most widely used instant messaging app worldwide.
facts.quote: The app had more than 3 billion active users in 2026 and is the most widely used instant messaging app worldwide.

facts.fact: Salesforce's page states that WhatsApp covers about 180 countries.
Salesforce's page states that WhatsApp was created in 2009.
facts.quote: Created in 2009, WhatsApp became popular by as a free version of SMS messaging.

facts.fact: Salesforce's page states that Facebook (now Meta) acquired WhatsApp in 2014 for $22 billion.
facts.quote: In 2014, the app was acquired by Facebook (now Meta) for $22 billion.

facts.fact: Salesforce's page states that WhatsApp Business was launched in 2018.
facts.quote: culminating in the launch of WhatsApp Business in 2018.

facts.fact: Salesforce's page states that WhatsApp Business broadcast lists can send the same message to up to 256 contacts at once.
facts.quote: They allow you to send the same message to up to 256 contacts at once.

facts.fact: Salesforce's page cites Meta data stating that more than a billion users connect corporate accounts to company messengers every week.
facts.quote: According to Meta data, more than a billion users connect corporate accounts to the company's messengers every week
